title: ElohimReputationProfileView
description: Source of truth: computed aggregation over the DHT-notarized outcome graph (mishpat DNA — GateDecisionAttestation + GateDecisionChallenge + ChallengeOutcome entries). This view is NOT a direct projection of any single table — it is derived from the attestation and challenge tables scoped to a time window. No elohim can assert its own reputation; it emerges from the accumulated public record. Dimensions are raw counts; weighting (time-decay, severity) is deferred to Phase 11+ and applied by consumers. If the projection tables and the DHT disagree, the DHT wins.

elohimId.description: AgentPubKey (base64) of the queried elohim agent

windowStart.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — start of the query window (inclusive)

windowEnd.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — end of the query window (inclusive)

currentSubstanceCid.description: CID of the most-recently-used ElohimSubstance in the window (null if no decisions in window)

totalDecisions.description: Count of GateDecisionAttestations where phase=elohim-active within the window. Dev-context decisions are excluded — they carry no reputation weight.

challengedCount.description: Count of distinct decisions (within window) that attracted at least one GateDecisionChallenge

upheldCount.description: Count of ChallengeOutcomes with verdict=upheld for challenges against this elohim's window decisions

dismissedCount.description: Count of ChallengeOutcomes with verdict=dismissed for challenges against this elohim's window decisions

supersededCount.description: Count of ChallengeOutcomes with verdict=superseded for challenges against this elohim's window decisions

pendingCount.description: Count of challenges against this elohim's window decisions that have no ChallengeOutcome yet

challengesByGrounds.description: Histogram of ChallengeGrounds values → count for all challenges in window. Keys are grounds strings (factual-error, safety, policy, constitutional, indemnification-request). Missing keys indicate zero challenges on those grounds.

outcomesByVerdict.description: Histogram of ChallengeVerdict values → count for all outcomes in window. Keys are verdict strings (upheld, dismissed, superseded). Missing keys indicate zero outcomes of that verdict.
